postal_system.postcode_rule: The current Postal Regulator page marks the S42-aligned National Addressing and Postcode System as coming soon. The April 2026 State House briefing says the four zero value currently used as a postcode is only a placeholder. Therefore 0000, arbitrary four digits, a P.O. Box, an island or district, a national address identifier, a parcel number and an AGID cell are not accepted as an authoritative Seychelles postcode. A future postcode becomes valid only from an effective authoritative schema and assignment release.
postal_system.identifier_split_rule: Recipient, organization, telephone and email, P.O. Box, island, district and subdistrict, road, place-linked National Address identifier, building number, parcel identifier, building identifier, future postcode and AGID remain separate typed objects with independent provenance and validity.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No currently assigned postcode means there is no canonical current Seychelles postcode polygon to infer. Island, district, subdistrict, enumeration area, parcel, building footprint, delivery route, P.O. Box, WebGIS view, buffer, Voronoi cell, model surface and AGID cell are not official postcode polygons. A virtual fallback remains explicitly virtual and an AGID cell remains an independent index.
postal_system.address_rule: The S42 National Addressing System is in transition. Cabinet decisions, rollout targets, Beau Vallon progress reports, proposed patterns and Bill approval do not prove a complete current national address assignment. Only a release-pinned authoritative place-linked assignment may be promoted.
postal_system.building_rule: An exact building may be returned only through an exact rights-cleared authoritative National Address-to-building relation with stable identifiers, or another explicitly reviewed official address/building relation. A postcode placeholder, P.O. Box, district, census frame, parcel containment, nearest WebGIS or OSM footprint, 2018 import, overlap and model score are candidate context only.
postal_system.cadastre_rule: Department of Lands WebGIS layers are informational and do not replace licensed surveys or title records. Parcel identifiers, cadastral geometry, ownership, occupancy, National Address and buildings remain separate; title or personal records require their own lawful controlled source.
postal_system.licence_rule: Postal Regulator and government pages, State House decisions, NBS census material, Department of Lands WebGIS and disclaimers, legislation reproductions and database rights retain source-specific terms. OSM and the 2018 Seychelles building import remain a separate attributed ODbL partition; a historical import does not grant access to a current government source database.
postal_system.privacy_rule: The Seychelles Data Protection Act 2023 requires safeguards including privacy by design, security, records and impact assessment and regulates cross-border data flows. Recipient, contact, precise household or address, P.O. Box subscriber, parcel-person, owner, occupant, delivery and query-log data remain gated.
postal_system.hosting_rule: Cloudflare and Hugging Face may host only rights-cleared non-personal immutable artifacts pinned to releases or Hub commits with verified digests. Controlled National Address, recipient, subscriber, household, parcel-person, owner, occupant, delivery, credential and precise query material requires approved access and cross-border handling.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID provides an independent spatial fallback where no authoritative postcode exists. Versioned crosswalks may relate permitted island, district, National Address, parcel, building and virtual review objects to AGID cells without presenting an AGID cell as an official Seychelles postcode, national address, administrative boundary or cadastral parcel.
